meta.title: TraceCart — Get it there.
meta.description: Sourcing, freight and customs under one roof, for goods that need to reach hard places. One delivered price, an honest arrival date, proof at the door.

hero.eyebrow: Sourcing and logistics for hard-to-reach places
hero.titleAfter: shipment knew the road to your door?
hero.subtitleRest: under one roof, built for goods delivered, not goods “in transit”.
hero.imageAlt: Goods handed over at the door, seen from below against a bright sky
hero.cardBody: Built for visibility, control and arrival dates you can plan around.
hero.cardChartLabel: Shipments per week, last twelve weeks

finder.title: Tell us what needs to move.
finder.body: A photo or a few words is enough. A person replies within 4 working hours with a delivered price.

trust.text: Trusted by {customers}+ importers, clinics and builders across {corridors} corridors

pov.before: Most forwarders sell a booking. We sell an arrival.
pov.accent: Every shipment has a price, a date and a person attached,
pov.after: and when something slips, you hear it from us first.
pov.team: One coordinator owns your shipment from supplier to door. No hand-offs between agents, no “it's with customs” and then silence.

services.title: Where should your next shipment start?

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.body: We find the product from a photo or a few words, confirm the supplier and check the goods before anything is paid.
sourcing.imageAlt: A coordinator checking goods at a supplier

freight.title: Freight & routing
freight.body: Sea, rail and road planned as one route, with the carrier that fits the load and the deadline.
freight.imageAlt: A truck loaded at a consolidation hub

customs.title: Customs
customs.body: Duties estimated up front, papers ready before the border, broker fees shown apart, and no coordination fee if you clear it yourself.
customs.imageAlt: A broker with documents at a land border

tracking.title: Tracking & delivery
tracking.body: Milestones as they happen, an arrival window that's honest, and photographed proof at the door.

results.title: Delivery you can point at.

process.yearsCaption: Years of combined experience moving goods on these corridors.

tell.title: Tell us
tell.body: A photo, a description, or goods you already have. Pickup and delivery addresses, and when you need it.

price.title: Get one price
price.body: Route, customs and arrival window worked out. One delivered price, valid for a week.

follow.title: Follow it home
follow.body: Milestones as they happen, delays with a reason, and proof at the door.

compare.title: Same cargo. Different arrival.

price.them: Quoted in pieces: freight now, customs “on arrival”
price.us: One delivered price before you commit, customs shown apart

tracking.them: A tracking number that stops at the port
tracking.us: Milestones to the door, every delay with a reason

contact.us: One coordinator who calls you first

space.them: Pay for a full container or wait
space.us: Hub consolidation: pay for the space you use

compare.quote: Getting goods to a hard place isn't about the fastest truck. It's knowing, every day, where they are and when they'll arrive.

hardware.name: [Name A]
hardware.quote: I used to learn the real price when the truck arrived. Now I know it before I pay, and the date has held three times out of three.

clinic.name: [Name B]
clinic.quote: They checked our devices before quoting and had the papers ready at the border. Nothing sat in a warehouse waiting for us.

ngo.name: [Name C]
ngo.quote: When the border closed for two days, they told us before we noticed, with a new date. That's the whole job, done properly.

agri.name: [Name D]
agri.quote: One coordinator, one price, one route. We stopped running three suppliers and a spreadsheet to get pumps inland.

footer.stayBody: One note a month on corridors, borders and landed costs. No noise.
footer.disclaimer: Transit times and prices are estimates until quoted, and a quote holds until the date shown on it. Customs duties and taxes are set by the authorities and passed on at cost. Figures and customer stories on this page are illustrative. Trademarks belong to their owners.
